bossOutro.label: BROKEN BADGE
bossOutro.text: Inside the badge: ‘Directive: none shall reach the Undercroft.’ Beneath it, scratched by hand: ‘I never asked what was down there.’

pages.label: THE COMMISSION
pages.text: The Council built the Grounds around a single command: nothing below was ever to reach the light.

pages.label: THE KEEPER
pages.text: One Warden remained after the orders stopped coming. Duty outlived everyone who might have released him.

bossOutro.label: ORIGINAL STONE
bossOutro.text: Older than the machine: ‘Should the Colossus fall, know this—we tried to stop the Tide before it reached the Fields.’

chapter.intro: THE FOUNDRY STILL EXPECTS A SHIFT.

pages.label: THE UNDERCROFT
pages.text: Industry continued beneath the abandoned city. No workers remained, but every machine remembered its quota.

pages.label: THE CONTAINMENT
pages.text: The Colossus was not built to conquer. It was built to stand between the Crimson Tide and everything above.

chapter.title: THE MACHINE BELOW

items.blurb: Red and gold, and old rage.
items.name: The Crimson Fields

bossOutro.label: PAINTED PORTRAIT
bossOutro.text: Two children, laughing. On the back: ‘Elan and Mira—before the first Tear.’ In another hand: ‘Aldric. Come home.’

pages.label: THE CRIMSON FIELDS
pages.text: A kingdom burned so long that flame became weather. Its last king still patrols the borders of a country that is gone.

pages.label: THE CROWN
pages.text: Aldric calls it a throne. The ruins call it a grave. Neither word has persuaded him to leave.

bossOutro.label: HUNDREDS OF NAMES
bossOutro.text: Your name, cut into the wall again and again. At the bottom: ‘Go finish it. One of us should.’

chapter.intro: THE RULES THIN. THE MEMORY DOES NOT.

pages.label: THE VOIDSPIRE
pages.text: Here distance repeats itself and every motion leaves behind a version that believes it moved first.

pages.label: THE REFLECTION
pages.text: Something in the Spire has practiced your shape for years. It remembers a journey you have only just begun.

chapter.title: THE NAME IN THE WALL

bossOutro.label: THE QUIET
bossOutro.text: The Source was never an enemy. It was the wound the world kept reopening, wearing the shape of everyone who tried to close it.

pages.label: THE TEAR
pages.text: There is no fortress at the bottom of the world—only the wound every fortress was built to misunderstand.

pages.label: THE SOURCE
pages.text: It has worn every guardian sent to close it. Now it waits to learn whether your blade is another memory or an ending.
